import random, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import diff_test, reference
from crosscheck.crosscheck import CrossCheck
fails = 0
for case in range(120):
    rng = random.Random(777000 + case)
    stream = diff_test.make_stream(rng, nodes=rng.randint(3, 10), ext=rng.randint(2, 5),
                                   events=rng.randint(6, 20))
    # many repairs to stress cache identity/snapshot bookkeeping
    stream["events"] += [{"op": "repair", "id": "z%d" % (i % 4)} for i in range(6)]
    stream["settings"]["cache_slots"] = rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 8])
    req = {"streams": [stream]}
    exp = reference.answer(req)
    out=[]
    for s in req["streams"]:
        e=CrossCheck(s["topology"]); out.append({"events": e.replay(s["events"], s["settings"])})
    if {"streams": out} != exp:
        fails += 1
        print("MISMATCH", case)
        break
print("cache-heavy fuzz cases 120, failures", fails)
PYEOF
